title: LoadingState
description: Page, route and section loading: a decorative ProgressIndicator spinner next to a visible label, inside a single polite status region.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: The default label is localized; the visible text is what screen readers announce.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: small, medium and large set minimum heights of 64, 160 and 240 px.

LoadingStateProps.label: Visible text, also announced by the status region

cssVars.--loading-state-gap: Space between the spinner and the label
cssVars.--loading-state-min-height: Minimum height (every size; defaults to the height of the size)
cssVars.--loading-state-color: Color of the label and the spinner

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A spinner next to a visible label (localized "Loading..." by default) in a polite status region.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: small, medium and large set the minimum height; the default slot holds a rich label.

section.title: Loading a section
section.description: The element does not set aria-busy: mark the container busy while it loads, then swap the placeholder for the content.
